Amazon Web Services China Regions

Amazon Web Services Beijing Region operated by Sinnet

Based on its infrastructure in Beijing and adjacent areas as well as cloud technologies from Amazon Web Services, Beijing Sinnet Technology Co., Ltd. (Sinnet) operates and provides cloud services in Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region.

Amazon Web Services Ningxia Region operated by NWCD

Based on its infrastructure in Ningxia and cloud technologies from Amazon Web Services, Ningxia Western Cloud Data Technology Co., Ltd. (NWCD) operates and provides cloud services in Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region.

Getting Started with Amazon Web Services China

    Customers who wish to use Amazon Web Services resources in either Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region operated by Sinnet, or China (Ningxia) Region operated by NWCD, or both, are required to create an Amazon Web Services (China) Account, a set of credentials that are distinct and separate from other Amazon Web Services global Accounts. Only customers with an Amazon Web Services (China) Account will be able to use resources in China regions. All customers who wish to use other Amazon Web Services global regions outside of China will need to create a Amazon Web Services global Account by visiting here.

    Click here to request a new Amazon Web Services (China) Account »

    In accordance with Chinese law and regulations, the State subjects non-commercial internet information services to a record-filing system and commercial internet information services to a permit system. No one may engage in the provision of internet information services without having carried out record-filing procedures or obtained permission. If you use Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region or Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region to host a website providing non-commercial Internet information services, you must undertake filing procedures for this non-commercial website (an “ICP Recordal”).

    Sinnet, as the operator of Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region, is also the licensed provider responsible for supporting and verifying ICP Recordal and ICP License for Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region customers.To learn more information, please refer to Sinnet website.

    NWCD, as the operator of Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region, is also the licensed provider responsible for supporting and verifying ICP Recordal and ICP License for Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region customers. To learn more information, please refer to NWCD website.

    Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region operated by Sinnet and Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region operated by NWCD offer a technology service platform that is similar to other Amazon Web Services Regions around the world. Developers can easily and efficiently deploy cloud-based applications inside of China with the same APIs, protocols, and de-facto operating standards used by Amazon Web Services customers around the world.Like other Amazon Web Services Regions, data or objects stored in Amazon Web Services China (Beijing) Region and Amazon Web Services China (Ningxia) Region remain exclusively in the Regions unless moved to other locations by the customer.

    Learn more about Amazon Web Services products and features »

Why Amazon Web Services China

Long-term commitment in China

Since Amazon Web Services started its operation in China in 2013, it keeps expanding and extending its infrastructure and business in China. It has built Beijing Region, Ningxia Region, Hong Kong Region, an AI lab in Shanghai, and IoT labs in Shenzhen and Taipei, providing enhanced technology supports for enterprises.


Compliant with China’s legal and regulatory requirements

Amazon Web Services provides infrastructure tailored for China: Amazon Web Service China Regions are located within Chinese mainland, and Amazon Web Services also provides ICP filing services. China Regions’ operations are separate from Amazon Web Services Global Regions. Therefore, you must create an Amazon Web Services account for accessing the China Regions.


Globally consistent experience

Customers of Amazon Web Services China will have the same cloud service experience and enjoy the same level of security that they do when accessing Amazon Web Services Global Regions. APIs, SDKs, and CLIs for Amazon Web Services China Regions are the same as those for Amazon Web Services Global Regions. Therefore, developers do not need additional training to use services in Amazon Web Services China Regions to deploy their applications.
